comparisons.claim: F3: avoid charging predictable task work
comparisons.evidence: K1 first filters at 10.927 s and stops at 12.541 s (nonlinear_retries_exhausted); K2/K3/K4 match nominal bitwise. This is accounting/filter evidence, not proof of unavoidable physical infeasibility.
No-human mismatch gives maximum |pR-pH|=0.084082 W and minimum R=0.067042 J; H remains .12 J. No residual intervention is required in this finite window.
Residual-only K2 reaches H=-0.067435 J and 0.295100 W peak output. K4 completes with H=0.046791 J minimum and peak 0.148221 W. K3 only demonstrates a protected prefix.
Executed power decomposition is independently checked for every mode. Completion and task quality must be read separately from that accounting identity.
K4 helping/blocking discards 0.082968 J of H charging at the .15 J cap; final H=0.068212 J. Net H output=-0.031180 J, gross=0.081788 J.

K3/K4 have identical pre-governor trajectories and constraints. Primary K3 stops before release, so its post-release peak is unavailable; this comparison establishes K4 completion on this fixture, not the reference paper's numerical recovery reduction.
